units.source_text: 就寝前必须再去巡视一遍金阁。

en.t: Before going to bed, I had to make one more round of inspection at the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 路经沉睡的鹿苑寺大雄宝殿，再过了唐门前，踏上了通向金阔的路。

en.t: Passing by the sleeping main hall of Rokuonji, then going past the Chinese gate, I stepped onto the road leading to the Golden Pavilion.
